senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (चरति)
1 To go.
2 To eat.
3 To behave or act, (in this sense आङ् is usually prefixed);
With अति and आङ् prefixed,
To transgress, to go astray.
With अभि,
1 To deceive, to betray.
2 To conjure.
3 To attend.
With अनु.
1 To follow, to attend.
2 To imitate.
With आङ्,
1 To practise a duty.
With उत्,
(उच्चरते)
1 To transgress.
2 To expel.
(उच्चरति)
To go up, to rise.
With उप,
1 To approach.
2 To worship.
With परि,
To serve.
With प्र,
1 To prevail as a custom.
2 To declare, to manifest.
With वि and अभि,
To go astray, to act wickedly.
With सम्
(सञ्चरते)
1 To ride upon.
(सञ्चरति)
To accompany.
With सम and आङ्,
1 To perform.
2 To announce.
r. 10th cl. (चारयति)
1 To doubt.
2 To be free from doubt.
With वि prefixed,
To discuss, to dispute, to reason upon or respecting any doubtful points.

mfn. (-रः-रा or री-रं)
1 Moveable, locomotive.
2 Trembling, shaking, unsteady.
m. (-रः)
1 A spy, a secret emissary or agent.
2 The planet Mars.
3 A game played with dice and men, similar to backgammon.
4 A wagtail.
5 A cowri.
6 The seventh Karaṇa, (in Astrology.)
7 The Karaṇas collectively.
f. (-री)
A young woman.
E.
चर to go, affix अच् or टच्, and in the latter case the fem. affix is ङीप्.

m. (-रः)
1 Going, motion.
2 A spy, a secret agent or emissary.
3 Binding, a binding, a fetter, &c.
4 A prison, a house of confinement.
5 A kind of tree, the Piyal, (Buchanania latifolia, Rox.) see प्रियाल.
6 Wandering about, travelling.
n. (-रं)
A factitious poison.
E.
चर going, &c. affix अण्.

m. (-कः)
1 The author of a treatise upon medicine: applied also to the work.
2 A spy or secret emissary, &c.
E.
चर to go, Uṇādi affix क्वुन्.

m. (-कः)
1 A groom, a horseman, a cavalier.
2 A binding, a fetter.
3 An associate, a companion.
E.
चर to go, in the causal form, and वुन् aff.

m. (-टः)
A wagtail; also चर.

mn. (-णः-णं)
1 A foot.
2 The root of a tree.
3 A race, a family.
4 A portion of the Vedas.
5 Fixed or instituted observances.
6 The peculiarity of condition or conduct implied by the English affix hood, as manhood, priesthood, &c.
7 The fourth part of a stanza.
8 (In Prosody,) A dactyl.
n. (-णं)
1 Wandering, roaming, going round or about.
2 Eating.
E.
चर to go, affix ल्युट्.

m. (-णः)
1 A dancer, a mime.
2 An actor of note.
3 A reader of scripture.
4 A panegyrist of the gods.
5 A bard, a herald.
E.
चर in the causal, to cause to go, to diffuse, (fame, &c.) and ल्युट् aff.

n. (-यं)
The foot of a lover, a deity, &c.
E.
चरण, and किशलय lotus filament.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Fallen at one's feet, prostrate.
E.
चरण, and गत gone.

f. (-न्थिः)
The ancle.
E.
चरण the foot, and ग्रन्थि a joint.

n. (-नं)
Prostration, falling at the feet.
E.
चरण, and पतन falling.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Prostrate, fallen at the feet.
E.
चरण, and पतित fallen.

m. (-तः)
Tread, trampling, foot-fall.
E.
चरण, and पात falling.

m. (-गं)
1 Both the feet.
2 Two lines of a stanza.
E.
चरण, and युग a pair.

f. (-बा)
Service, devotion.
E.
चरण, and सेवा service.

n. (-र्द्धं)
1 The half of the foot.
2 Half of the fourth of a stanza.
E.
चरण, and अर्द्ध half.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Trodden down, bent or bowed under the feet.
E.
चरण, and आनमित bowed.

n. (-णं)
An ornament on the feet.
E.
चरण, and आभरण ornament.

n. (-तं)
The water in which the feet of a venerable Brahman or teacher have been washed.
E.
चरण, and अमृत nectar.

m. (-धः)
A cock.
E.
चरण the foot, and आयुध a weapon, whose foot is his weapon.

n. (-न्दं)
The foot (of a deity, a lover, &c.)
E.
चरण, and अरविन्द a lotus; also many similar compounds, as चरणपद्मं, चरणकमल, चरणनलिनं, &c.

n. (-नं)
Trampling, treading on.
E.
चरण, and आस्कन्दन going.

n. (-कं)
Water in which the feet of a venerable Brahman or spiritual teacher have been washed.
E.
चरण, and उदक water.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
In contact with the feet, at the feet.
E.
चरण, and उपग approached.

mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्)
Going, going to.
E.
चर to go, शतृ aff.

m. (-ष्टः)
A mediator.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Last, ultimate, final.
2 West, western. चर to go, अम Uṇādi aff.

m. (-भृत्)
The western mountain behind which the sun is supposed to set.
E.
चरम western, and क्ष्माभृत् a mountain; also चरमाचल, &c.

m. (-लः)
See the preceding.

m. (-द्रिः)
See चरमक्ष्माभृत्; also other similar compounds.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
1 Moveable, locomotive.
2 Shaking, trembling, unsteady.
3 Wished, desired.
4 Moveable and immoveable.
n. (-रं)
1 The world.
2 Sky, atmosphere.
3 Heaven, paradise.
4 The aggregate of all things, whether inanimate or animate.
E.
चर to go, affix अच, and the derivative reiterated, आङ् inserted; or चर what goes, and अचर what does not go.

m. (-रिः)
An animal in general.
E.
चर locomotive, and इ Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Gone, gone to, attained.
n. (-तं)
Fixed institute, proper or peculiar observance: see चरण.
2 Story, adventures.
3 Practice, behaviour.
4 Nature.
E.
चर to go, affix क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Caused to go.
2 Distilled.
E.
चर to go, causal form, क्त aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be followed or observed.
E.
चर, and तव्य aff.

mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं)
1 Effected, accomplished.
2 Successful.
E.
चरित, and अर्थ object.

n. (-त्वं)
1 Accompaniment, assistance.
2 Meritorious conduct.
E.
चरित, and गुणत्व faculty.

n. (-त्रं)
1 Instituted and peculiar observance or conduct.
2 Story, adventures.
3 Practice, habit, behaviour.
4 Nature, disposition.
f. (-त्रा)
The tamarind tree.
E.
चर to go, इत्र Uṇādi aff.

n. (-त्रं)
Practice, conduct, behaviour: see चरित्र.

n. (-त्रं)
Peculiar observance or practice, peculiarity of customs or condition: see चरण.
f. (-त्रा)
The tamarind tree.
E.
चर to go, नित्रन् Uṇādi affix; also चरित्र, &c.

n. (-कं)
A friendly pledge, one of unequal value to the loan.
E.
चरित्र, and बन्धक a pledge.

mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु)
1 Moveable, locomotive.
2 Wandering about.
E.
चर to go, and इष्णुच् aff.

m. (-रुः)
1 An oblation of rice, barley, and pulse, boiled with butter and milk for presentation to the gods or manes.
2 The vessel in which such an oblation is prepared.
E.
चर to eat, उण् Uṇādi affix, what the gods feed upon.

mfn. (-रुः-र्व्वी-रु)
Beautiful, elegant.
m. (-रुः)
A name of VṚHASPATI, regent of JUPITER, and preceptor of the gods.
E.
चर to go, Uṇādi affix ञुण्.

m. (-णः)
A kind of cake.
E.
चर to eat, उ affix, edible, and व्रण what is ground or pounded.

n. (-णं)
Sprinkling an oblation of milk and ghee.
E.
चरु and श्रपण scattering.

f. (-ला)
The vessel in which an oblation is prepared.
E.
चरु, and स्थाली a pot.

r. 1st cl. (चर्घत्ति)
To go or move.

r. 1st and 6th cls. (चर्चति)
1 To speak or say.
2 To abuse, to reprove, to censure or condemn.
3 To injure or hurt.
4 To inquire.
r. 10th cl. (चर्चयति)
To read over, to peruse carefully, to study; also read चर्च्च.

f. (-चा)
1 Reflexion, consideration, the exercise of judgment or deliberation.
2 Cleaning the person with fragrant unguents.
3 Inquiry, investigation.
4 A name of the goddess DURGĀ.
E.
चर्च to read, &c. affixes अङ् and टाप्; also चर्चिका, &c.

r. 1st and 10th cls. (चर्च्चते चर्च्चयते)
1 To speak, to tell.
2 To reprove.
3 To study: see चर्च.

f. (-री)
1 A festival, festive sport.
2 A kind of song.
3 Striking the hands to beat time.
4 Curled or woolly hair.
5 Musical symphony or, the recitation of scholars.
6 The noise made at festivals, &c.
7 Flattery, dishonest praise.
E.
चर्च to speak or say, to sound, &c. रल and ङीष् affs.

m. (-कः)
1 A form of ŚIVA.
2 A potherb.
3 Decorating or curling the hair.
E.
चर्चरी noise, &c. and क who utters, from कै to sound, affix ड; some authorities substitute बर्चरीक for this word.

f. (-का)
1 The goddess DURGĀ or CĀMUṆḌĀ.
2 Cleaning the person with perfumes.
3 Deliberation, inquiry.
E.
चर्च to ask, affix ण्वुल्; also चर्चा as above.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Perfumed, anointed, smeared with sandal, &c.
2 Sought, desired.
3 Inquired into or after, investigated.
E.
चर्चा smearing, &c. and इतच् aff.

mfn. (-र्त्त्यः-र्त्त्या-र्त्त्यं)
1 To be hurt or injured.
2 To be strung or tied in order.
E.
चृत to hurt, &c. and क्यप् affix, form special.

m. (-टः)
1 The open palm of the hand with fingers extended.
2 A plant, (Mollugo pentaphylla.)
3 A quantity of bubbles or specks, (स्फारविपुल.)
f. (-टी)
A thin cake or biscuit of flour.
E.
चर्प a Sautra root, to be low or flat, affix अटच्; also चपट and चपेट.

r. 1st cl. (चर्बति)
To go, to move.

m. (-टः)
A kind of cucumber, (C. utilatissimus): see इर्व्वारु.
f. (-टी)
The noise of merriment or festivity: see चर्च्चरी.
E.
चारु agreeable sound, and भट what makes, deriv. irr.

n. (-र्म्म)
A shield: see चर्म्मन्.

mfn. (-र्म्मः-र्म्मी-र्म्मं)
1 Covered with leather, (a car, &c.)
2 Defended by a hide or skin.
3 Shielded, having a shield.
E.
चर्म्म leather, and अण् aff.

n. (-णं)
Working in skins or leather.
E.
चर्म्म, and करण making.

f. (-षा)
A plant, commonly called by a similar name Carmakaṣā or Carmaghās.
E.
चर्म्म the skin, and कष what injures; also चर्म्मकसा.

m. (-रः)
The shoe-maker, a currier or worker in leather, the offspring of a Caṇḍāla woman by a man of the fisherman caste, or of a Vaideha female by a Niṣada.
f. (-री)
1 The plant Carmaghās: see the preceding.
2 The wife of a Carmakāra.
E.
चर्म्म skin or leather, and कार who does or makes.

m.
A worker in leather.
E.
चर्म्म, and कारक making.

m. (-री)
A currier, a worker in hides or leather.
E.
चर्म्म, and कारिन् who makes.

n. (-र्य्यं)
Working in leather or skins.
E.
चर्म्म, and कार्य्य business.

n. (-लं)
A wart.
E.
चर्म्म, and कील a bolt.

m. (-कृत्)
A shoe-maker: see चर्म्मकार.

f. (-का)
A bat.
E.
चर्म्म leather, and चटका a sparrow, the leather-winged sparrow; also चर्म्मचटिका, चर्म्मचटी, &c.

f. (-टी)
A bat.
E.
चर्म्म leather, and चट who hurts.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Produced by or from the skin.
n. (-जं)
1 Hair.
2 Blood.
E.
चर्म्म, and ज born.

f. (-ती)
1 A river that runs across Bundelkhand into the Ganges, the modern Chambal.
2 The plaintain tree, (Musa sapientum.)
E.
चर्म्मन् skin, and मतुप् poss. affix; न is changed to ण; it may also be dropped, and the word be written चर्म्मवती.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A wrinkle, a fold of skin.
E.
चर्म्म, and तरङ्ग a wave.

m. (-ण्डः)
A whip.
E.
चर्म्म a leather (thong), and दण्ड a stick.

f. (-का)
1 Leprosy.
2 Cutaneous disease.
E.
चर्म्म, and दूष to vitiate, ण्वुल् aff.

n. (-र्म्म)
1 Skin, hide, bark, &c.
2 A shield.
3 A student's hide, usually that of an antelope.
E.
चर to go, to obstruct, Uṇādi affix मनिन्.

f. (-का)
A whip.
E.
चर्म्म, and नासिका the nose or end.

f. (-का)
A piece or strap of leather, for playing upon with dice, a leather backgammon board, &c.
E.
चर्म्म, and पट्टिका a fillet.

f. (-त्रा)
A bat, the small house-bat.
E.
चर्म्म leather, and पत्र a wing, the fem. form implies diminutiveness.

f. (-का)
A leather shoe.
E.
चर्म्म, and पादुका a slipper.

f. (-का)
A shoe-maker's awl.
E.
चर्म्म leather, भिद to pierce, with प्र prefixed, and वुन् affixed.

mf. (-वकः-विका)
A bellows.
E.
चर्म्म leather, सिव to sew, प्र prefix, and वुन् affix; what is sewn or made of leather.

m. (-न्धः)
A leather band or strap.
E.
चर्म्म, and बन्ध band.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Leather, made of leather.
E.
चर्म्म, and मयट् aff.

f. (-ण्डा)
A form of the goddess DURGĀ.
E.
चर्म्म a shield, and मुण्ड a bald head; whose head is round like a shield.

f. (-ष्टिः)
A whip.
E.
चर्म्म, and यष्टि a stick.

m. (-रुः)
A shoe-maker, a worker in leather.
E.
चर्म्म leather, and रु to make a noise, affix क्विप्.

f. (-वा)
Cardamoms: see एला.
E.
चर्म्म skin, and सम्भव produced.

m. (-रः)
Lymph, serum.
E.
चर्म्म, and सार essence.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Covered with skin.
E.
चर्म्म, and आच्छादित covered.

n. (-नं)
Working in leather or skins.
E.
चर्म्म, and अवकर्त्तन cutting off.

m. (-र्त्ती)
A worker in leather or skins, a man of the lowest caste.
E.
चर्म्म, and अवकर्त्तिन् who cuts off.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
1 Covered with skin.
2 Tied with leather, &c.
E.
चर्म्म, and अवनद्ध bound.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Covered with skin or leather.
E.
चर्म्म, and आवृत covered.

n. (-म्भः)
Lymph, serum.
E.
चर्म्म, and अम्भस् water.

m. (-रः)
A worker in leather.
E.
चर्म्म, and ऋ to go, with अच् aff.

mfn. (-र्म्मी-र्म्मिणी-र्म्मि)
1 Having a hide or skin.
2 Leather, made of leather, &c.
m. (-र्म्मी)
1 A soldier armed with a shield, a shield bearer.
2 A tree of which the bark is used for writing upon, &c. see भूर्ज, a sort of birch.
3 One of ŚIVA'S doorkeepers: see भृङ्गरीट.
4 A plantain.
E.
चर्म्म skin, a shield, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
To be gone, (in or by.)
nf. (-र्य्यं-र्य्या)
1 Perseverance in religious austerities.
2 Due and regular observance of all rites or customs.
3 Following the rules of studentship.
4 Going.
5 Eating.
6 Practice, usage.
7 Behaviour.
E.
चर to go, and यत् or ण्यत् aff.

r. 1st and 10th cls. (चर्वति चर्व्वयति)
To eat, to chew, to masticate.

n. (-णं)
Chewing, masticating.
E.
चर्व्व to chew, and ल्युट् aff.

m. (-र्व्वा)
Striking with the flat of the hand.
E.
चर to go, affix वन्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Eaten.
2 Chewed.
E.
चर्व्व to eat, and क्त aff.

n. (-त्रं)
A spitting pot.
E.
चर्व्वित chewed, (pān or tobacco,) पात्र a vessel; also चर्व्वितपात्रकं.

mfn. (-र्व्व्यः-र्व्व्या-र्व्व्यं)
To be chewed.
n. (-र्व्व्यं)
Solid food, requiring mastication.
E.
चर्व्व to chew, यत् affix; also चर्व्वणीय, चर्व्वितव्य.

m. (-णिः)
A man.

n. (-ण्डं)
Ascenscional difference, (in Astronomy.)
E.
चार, and काण्ड part.

n. (-क्षुः)
Espionage.
m. (-क्षुः)
One (a king, &c.) who employs spies.
E.
चार, and चक्षुस् eye.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Graceful in gait or motion.
E.
चार and चणप् aff.

mfn. (-ञ्चुः-ञ्चुः-ञ्च)
Remarkable in walking, of graceful carriage.
E.
चार, and चुञ्चुप् aff.

f. (-ज्या)
The sine of the ascensional^1 difference.
E.
चार and ज्या a sine.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

f. (-टी)
A plant: see पद्मचारिणी.
E.
चर in the causal, what makes go or disperses, (disease,) अटन् aff.

f. plur. (-राः)
Female dancers, actresses, &c.
E.
चारण and दारा wives.

m. (-थः)
A meeting of two roads.
E.
चार a passenger, and पथिन् a road, ष affix, which leaves अ final.

m. (-टः)
A hero, a chief or warrior.
E.
चार diffusion, (of praise, &c.) and भट who desires.

ind.
1 Having enjoined or prescribed, having caused to observe.
2 Having made to go.
E.
चर to go, causal form, क्त्वा aff.

m. (-युः)
Summer-air, zephyr.
E.
चार causing to go, and वायु air or wind.

m. (-तः)
A secret emissary or spy.
E.
चार, and अन्तरित concealed.

f. (-का)
A cockroach.

f. (-क्)
A plant: see कर्क्कटशृङ्गी.

n. (-त्र्यं)
Becoming practices, moral conduct or instituted observance.
E.
चरित्र, and ष्यञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
The seed of the Sara cane.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-र्भः)
A son of KṚṢṆA.
E.
चारु, and गर्भ asylum.

m. (-प्तः)
A son of KṚṢṆA.
E.
चारु, and गुप्त preserved.

f. (-ता)
Loveliness, beauty.
E.
तल् added to चारु; also with त्व added चारुत्वं.

m. (-ष्णः)
The son of KṚṢṆA by RUKMIṆĪ.

m. (-मा)
A plant: see शठी.

f. (-रा)
A name of SACI the wife of INDRA.
E.
चारु beautiful, and धारा fame, splendor, &c. some authorities read चारुधामा, from चारु, and धामन् abode.

f. (-ला)
A grape.
E.
चारु beautiful, and फल fruit.
